The CRM has three companies in Cologne, all with a Köln address. Sofia Meier owns all three, so the visit is her call. Check with her before you go. None of them has an open deal or a contact on file.

| Company | Address | Last activity | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Rheinufer AG** | Konrad-Adenauer-Ufer 41, 50668 (by the Rhine, central) | 15 Oct | The only logged activity is "Wartungsvertrag – Verlängerung" (maintenance contract renewal). A renewal visit is the most natural fit. |
| **Vorort Systeme KG** | Neusser Landstraße 384, 50769 (north, Niehl/Longerich area) | 18 Oct | Three callback activities in the last three days. Their subjects say "Rückruf Aachener Metallwerke", which is a different company's name. Check that before you walk in. |
| **Dom Digital GmbH** | Unter Sachsenhausen 21, 50667 (city centre, by the cathedral) | None | No history at all, so a visit would be a cold one. |

- **Best bet:** Rheinufer AG, because it has a recent, concrete reason to talk and is central. Dom Digital is a short walk from there if you have time.
- **Gaps:** Because no contacts are linked, I can't name who to ask for. I also found nothing in the surrounding towns I checked (Leverkusen, Bonn, Düsseldorf and a few others). I only searched address cities, so a company with no address recorded wouldn't show up.

I haven't changed anything in the CRM. I can log the visit afterwards or leave Sofia a task about the Vorort Systeme records if you want.
